facts.statement: Errolosteus is an extinct species of buchanosteid arthrodire placoderm.
facts.quote: Errolosteus goodradigbeensis is an extinct buchanosteid arthrodire placoderm.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen ANU 21806 was described alongside its relative Arenipiscis.
facts.quote: The holotype of E. goodradigbeensis, ANU 21806, was described at the same time as its sympatric relative, Arenipiscis.

facts.statement: Errolosteus is distinguished from other species by its short and broad skull.
facts.quote: Errolosteus can be distinguished by having a comparatively short, broad skull.

facts.statement: Fossils of Errolosteus have been found in Emsian-aged marine rocks in New South Wales, Australia.
facts.quote: Its fossils have been found in Emsian-aged marine strata of the Murrumbidgee Group in New South Wales, Australia.

facts.statement: Errolosteus lived between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago during the Emsian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Emsian to Emsian (410.62 to 393.47 million years ago)

facts.statement: Errolosteus belongs to the parent group Arthrodira.
Errolosteus is classified in the class Placodermi.
